items.title: Former DUP leader Donaldson sentenced to 15 years in prison for child sex abuse
items.summary: Jeffrey Donaldson was convicted of 18 counts of sex abuse, including one of rape, which he committed against two women when they were children.

items.title: Man and woman arrested after two adults and two children killed in house fire
items.summary: Two people have been arrested over the deaths of two adults and two children in a suspected arson attack on a house in Ireland.

items.title: Trans people should use hospital spaces according to biological sex, NHS England says
items.summary: New guidance says trans patients should be cared for on single-sex hospital wards or bays that align with their biological sex.

items.title: Wildlife park to reopen after man killed by tiger
items.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park, which was closed after a man was killed by a tiger, is to reopen on Friday.

items.title: Man killed by tiger died from 'multiple injuries'
items.summary: William Chapman climbed two fences to enter a tiger's pen at Yorkshire Wildlife Park, an inquest hears.

items.title: Trans patients to be placed on wards according to their birth sex in England
items.summary: Transgender patients should be placed on hospital wards according to their birth sex rather than their gender identity, according to new guidance.
